item.title: California startups have raised a record $385B across seed to growth rounds so far in 2026, or 75%+ of all US startup funding; early and seed stage raised ~$62B (Joanna Glasner/Crunchbase News)
item.description:
Joanna Glasner / Crunchbase News:
California startups have raised a record $385B across seed to growth rounds so far in 2026, or 75%+ of all US startup funding; early and seed stage raised ~$62B  —  California companies have scooped up more than three-fourths of all U.S. startup funding this year.  That, per Crunchbase data, is an apparent record share.

Original (direct link): https://news.crunchbase.com/venture/california-startups-most-us-funding-2026-openai-anthropic/

item.title: Cathedral, a months-old cybersecurity startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers, says it breached Anthropic's internal systems in under 12 hours using AI agents (Washington Post)
item.description:

Cathedral, a months-old cybersecurity startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers, says it breached Anthropic's internal systems in under 12 hours using AI agents  —  The start-up firm Cathedral has told makers of the Claude chatbot that its researchers were able to quickly penetrate sensitive systems, a report reviewed by The Post shows.

item.description:

Modern AI panic reflects “cognitive mercantilism”, a zero-sum worldview where intelligence is hoarded as a scarce supply-side commodity managed by elites  —  AI panic weirdly resembles the anxiety that accompanied early capitalism  —  I've been reading Joyce Appleby's The Relentless Revolution …
